title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits: Titanium Elite and Ambassador Elite Self-Parking Savings Percent (Guest Folios)
content:
The two top tiers of Ashbury Rewards receive a tier parking benefit on the self-parking savings percent of their stays on Guest Folios.

**Term.** Tier parking benefit: for an Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite member the self-parking savings percent is the combined saving percent scaled, multiplied by the Ambassador saving scale of 2; for an Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite member it is the combined saving percent supplemented, with the Titanium saving supplement of 4 percentage points added to it. A member of any other tier receives no tier parking benefit: the self-parking savings percent is the combined saving percent as it stands.

The combined saving percent is the member parking saving percent with every percentage point added to it for the stay, summed into one percentage; the Ambassador scale multiplies that whole percentage, and the Titanium supplement is added to that whole percentage. The tier is the tier shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay.

| Ashbury Rewards tier | Self-parking savings percent |
|---|---|
| Ambassador Elite | The combined saving percent multiplied by 2 |
| Titanium Elite | The combined saving percent plus 4 percentage points |
| Any other tier | The combined saving percent as it stands |

## Worked figures (hypothetical combined saving percents)

| Hypothetical combined saving percent | Ambassador Elite | Titanium Elite | Platinum Elite |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4% | 8% | 8% | 4% |
| 10% | 20% | 14% | 10% |
| 7% | 14% | 11% | 7% |

With a combined saving percent of 10%, an Ambassador Elite member's 20% applies once to the self-parking charged of the stay: on $200.00 of self-parking, $40.00.
